svg.title: CNC operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as cnc operator, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A CNC control panel displays a stepped tool path beside a separate helical milling cutter. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
